question.question: Does append_notify preserve the submitted entry identity when an old leader Assigned reply arrives after a new leader has decided another entry at that index?
question.importance: False success could cause an application to acknowledge a write that is absent from the decided log even if core consensus agreement remains intact.
event_paths: AppendNotify -> TaggedProposal -> old leader acceptance -> delayed Assigned
New leader Prepare/Promise -> AcceptSync -> replacement append/decision
Origin receives delayed Assigned -> periodic drain_notifiers -> future result

supporting_behavior_ids.b-form: New leader selects history and forms a decision without the isolated old leader unchosen entry.
supporting_behavior_ids.b-follow: Origin accepts new leader synchronization and decision under a higher promise.
supporting_behavior_ids.b-prepare: Acquires new ballot authority and reports history.
supporting_behavior_ids.b-read: Exposes the live decided entry for the completion index.

counterevidence: Superseded explicitly handles assigned older ballots when the index is not yet decided.
EntryId matching prevents attaching a reply to a different pending request.
Stable-leader gate prevents assignment while the leader is in Prepare.
unknowns: Need execution of the real message-producing actors and a legal per-link ordered schedule to establish late assignment after replacement decision.
question.trigger_rationale: The first drain branch ignores assignment ballot once idx <= decided. The origin can remain unassigned during takeover, so earlier ticks need not trigger Superseded. A controlled real-message history distinguishes this from a guard that merely looks incomplete locally. Configuration isolation has less settled caller applicability, and buffered StopSign progress has weaker completion grounding; this question has a concrete success contract and a smaller safety oracle.

obligation.description: If append_notify completes successfully with an assigned log index, the decided entry at that index must be the entry submitted by that invocation, including when leadership changes between acceptance and notification. Timeout or Superseded is permitted instead of success.

scope.description: The captured async runtime over one valid three-node core configuration, distinct comparable entry payloads, no compaction or crash, and real core/runtime messages delivered by the caller. A partition may delay an old leader response while a different quorum elects a new leader and decides a different entry.
assumptions: Each node has a unique configured id and initially empty MemoryStorage.
Application supplies transport; no messages or state are fabricated or modified.
Success is interpreted at the one-based accepted index returned by the runtime; core read offset is index minus one.
excluded: No guarantee that an arbitrary admitted invocation succeeds.
No global consensus agreement violation is asserted.
Crash persistence, reconfiguration, snapshotting and batching are outside this check.

grounding.derivation: The public method says append an entry and await its decided log index. The Superseded documentation permits stopping conservatively when a leader changes because the entry might still survive; this permits false-negative errors, not success for another value. Assignment records index and ballot at acceptance, while core consensus may replace unchosen values across ballots. Therefore success requires the requested entry, not solely a decided numeric position.
grounding.applicability: Use the original caller invocation, its real tagged EntryId and real assignment; correlate successful response with the live decided log at the same origin.
alternatives: Superseded or Timeout can satisfy the safety requirement without deciding the input.
If new leader retains the original value, successful notification is consistent with the requirement.

associations.rationale: This consumer produces the successful result governed by the public append_notify identity contract.

bindings.description: Consumes pending assignment and current decided index to resolve append_notify; success is tested before ballot supersession.
